create_mlx_vlm_engine: create an MlxVlmEngine instance with options, artifacts_path, and optional model_config for Apple Silicon VLM inference
initialize_mlx_model: initialize the MLX VLM engine by loading the model and processor from a HuggingFace repository
run_predict_batch: run predict_batch on a list of VlmEngineInput objects to generate text outputs from images using the MLX model
load_model_for_repo: load an MLX model and processor from a HuggingFace repository ID with a specified revision
cleanup_mlx_resources: cleanup MLX model resources by deleting the vlm_model and processor instances
